commits.message:
fix(contrast)!: contrast holds where it is promised (rich-contrast-sqqq) (#301)

* fix(contrast)!: text-* reads on *-muted, grounded defaults read at 16 colours, readableOn measures in a named terminal (rich-contrast-sqqq)

- buildPalette holds text-* to 4.5 on *-muted through ensureContrast; the
  authored registry palettes' text-* values are corrected to clear it. The
  widget contrast floor is now 4.5.
- getGroundedStyle: below 256 colours Syntax's highlighted line number and
  Markdown's code are drawn without their fixed pair, as Rich's
  Syntax._get_number_styles does — no pair of ANSI slots reads in every
  bundled theme. markdown.code is bold, as Rich's is, so code stays distinct.
- BREAKING: colorFuncs / richTextFuncs / readableOnFunc take
  () => DrawnAt ({ depth, terminal? }) instead of () => ColorDepth.

* fix(contrast): one text-* rule for derived and authored palettes, grounded pairs dropped only when a depth repaints them (rich-contrast-sqqq)

Review findings on PR #301:
- text-* is held by accentText, toward the palette's own text side, in
  buildPalette and in registry hydration; the 18 hand-tuned data files are
  Textual's values again. textual-ansi's text-* had gone near-black (1.09:1
  on its background) because its *-muted sits at the 0.179 cutoff.
- groundedStyle drops a style's colours only when it paints a fixed ground
  and the depth turns a fixed colour of the pair into a terminal slot, so a
  user's 'bold magenta' or 'white on blue' is drawn as written. The 16-slot
  depth switch is gone.
- Markdown inline code resolves through RichText's resolveStyle again, so a
  bad inlineCodeStyle reaches onStyleError instead of throwing.
- The 16-colour sweep renders each grounded default through its drawer.

* docs(contrast): text-* holds the muted floor first; the background pair yields where both cannot hold (rich-contrast-sqqq)
